targets.rawSql: select count(distinct device_id) from analytics_events where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Новых игроков
panels.description: Устройства, впервые зашедшие в выбранный период

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from (select device_id, min(created_at) f from analytics_events group by 1) d where $__timeFilter(f)

panels.title: Матчей начато
panels.description: Считается у режиссёра, чтобы не умножать на игроков

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from analytics_events where name='match_start' and (props->>'host')::boolean is true and $__timeFilter(created_at)
select count(*) from analytics_events where name='match_end' and (props->>'host')::boolean is true and $__timeFilter(created_at)
select count(*) from analytics_events where name='room_create' and $__timeFilter(created_at)
select count(*) from analytics_events where name in ('share','clip_send','invite') and $__timeFilter(created_at)

select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,1d), count(distinct device_id) as "игроки", count(distinct device_id) filter (where name in ('match_start')) as "играли матч" from analytics_events where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 1

select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,1d), count(*) filter (where name='match_start' and (props->>'host')::boolean is true) as "начато", count(*) filter (where name='match_end' and (props->>'host')::boolean is true) as "доиграно", count(*) filter (where name='match_exit') as "вышли посреди" from analytics_events where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Воронка (устройства за период)
panels.description: Сколько устройств дошли до шага (шаг мог быть и без предыдущего)

targets.rawSql:
select шаг, n from (with e as (select device_id, name, props from analytics_events where $__timeFilter(created_at))
select 'Зашли' as шаг, count(distinct device_id) as n, 1 as o from e
union all select 'Начали обучение', count(distinct device_id), 2 from e where name='tutorial_start'
union all select 'В комнате', count(distinct device_id), 3 from e where name in ('room_create','room_join')
union all select 'Позвали друзей', count(distinct device_id), 4 from e where name in ('invite','invite_tap','invite_create')
union all select 'Матч начат', count(distinct device_id), 5 from e where name='match_start'
union all select 'Матч доигран', count(distinct device_id), 6 from e where name='match_end'
union all select 'Ещё матч', count(distinct device_id), 7 from e where name='rematch'
union all select 'Поделились клипом', count(distinct device_id), 8 from e where name in ('clip_send','share')
) f order by o

panels.title: Откуда пришли (первый источник)
panels.description: src0: метка ?src= в первой ссылке, ref — с другого сайта, direct — напрямую

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(nullif(src0,''),'—') as источник, count(*) as n from (
  select distinct on (device_id) device_id, props->>'src0' as src0 from analytics_events where $__timeFilter(created_at) order by device_id, created_at) d
group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 12
select coalesce(props->>'app', props->>'br', '—') as где, count(distinct device_id) n from analytics_events where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 10

panels.title: Как кончаются дубли
panels.description: stars — три звезды, time — время вышло, last — остался один…

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(props->>'reason','—') as причина, count(*) n from analytics_events where name='round_end' and (props->>'host')::boolean is true and $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc

select case props->>'accused' when 'right' then 'угадал' when 'wrong' then 'ошибся' else 'не обвинял' end as обвинение, count(*) n from analytics_events where name='round_end' and $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc

select round(avg((props->>'kill')::numeric),2) as "выбил", round(avg((props->>'stars')::numeric),2) as "звёзды", round(100.0*avg(((props->>'alive')::boolean)::int),0) as "выжил, %", round(100.0*avg(((props->>'caught')::boolean)::int),0) as "раскрыт, %", count(*) as "дублей"
from analytics_events where name='round_end' and $__timeFilter(created_at)

with f as (select device_id, min(created_at)::date d0 from analytics_events group by 1),
a as (select distinct device_id, created_at::date d from analytics_events)
select f.d0 as "первый день", count(distinct f.device_id) as "новых",
 count(distinct a.device_id) filter (where a.d = f.d0 + 1) as "вернулись на 2-й день",
 count(distinct a.device_id) filter (where a.d between f.d0 + 2 and f.d0 + 7) as "вернулись за неделю"
from f left join a on a.device_id = f.device_id where $__timeFilter(f.d0::timestamptz) group by 1 order by 1 desc
select coalesce(props->>'error','—') as ошибка, count(*) as раз from analytics_events where name in ('room_error','room_create_fail') and $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Выключили звук, % игроков
panels.description: Из игравших матч — сколько выключили музыку или звуки в шестерёнке. Больше 25% — звук раздражает (план звука)

targets.rawSql:
select round(100.0*count(distinct device_id) filter (where name='sound_toggle' and props->>'on'='false' and props->>'what' in ('sfx','music'))
 / nullif(count(distinct device_id) filter (where name='match_start'),0),0) from analytics_events where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Что выключают
panels.description: sfx — звуки, music — музыка, room_music — режиссёр выбрал «Музыку в дубле», own_music — гость вернул музыку себе

targets.rawSql:
select (props->>'what') || case when props ? 'mode' then ': ' || (props->>'mode') else case when (props->>'on')::boolean then ' вкл' else ' выкл' end end as что,
 count(*) n from analytics_events where name='sound_toggle' and $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Кто вырезал
panels.description: Режиссёр вырезает за пропущенную команду «Море волнуется» («Жёсткий дубль»): растёт — сигнал не слышат

targets.rawSql:
select case props->>'out' when 'director' then 'режиссёр (пропустил команду)' when 'player' then 'игрок' else 'не вырезали' end as кто, count(*) n
 from analytics_events where name='round_end' and props ? 'out' and $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Доступность серверов: Москва и Европа (замер net_probe)
panels.description: Раз в сутки телефон пробует оба сервера (lib/netprobe.ts). Развилка этапа 3: Европа отвечает ≥ 95% игроков «Россия без VPN» — российский вход не нужен. «64 КБ» ловит фильтр, глушащий соединение после 16 КБ. Страна — по адресу (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0, db-ip.com)

targets.rawSql:
with p as (select device_id, props, case when props->>'cc'='RU' then 'Россия без VPN'
   when props->>'tz' = any(array['Europe/Moscow','Europe/Kaliningrad','Europe/Samara','Europe/Volgograd','Europe/Kirov','Europe/Astrakhan','Europe/Saratov','Europe/Ulyanovsk','Asia/Yekaterinburg','Asia/Omsk','Asia/Novosibirsk','Asia/Barnaul','Asia/Tomsk','Asia/Novokuznetsk','Asia/Krasnoyarsk','Asia/Irkutsk','Asia/Chita','Asia/Yakutsk','Asia/Khandyga','Asia/Vladivostok','Asia/Ust-Nera','Asia/Magadan','Asia/Sakhalin','Asia/Srednekolymsk','Asia/Kamchatka','Asia/Anadyr']) then 'Россия, скорее всего VPN' when props->>'cc' is null then 'страна неизвестна' else 'из-за границы' end as кто
   from analytics_events where name='net_probe' and $__timeFilter(created_at))
 select кто, count(distinct device_id) as телефонов,
  round(100.0*avg((props->>'msk_http')::int)) as "Москва: HTTPS %", round(100.0*avg((props->>'msk_big')::int)) as "Москва: 64 КБ %", round(100.0*avg((props->>'msk_ws')::int)) as "Москва: WS %",
  round(100.0*avg((props->>'eu_http')::int)) as "Европа: HTTPS %", round(100.0*avg((props->>'eu_big')::int)) as "Европа: 64 КБ %", round(100.0*avg((props->>'eu_ws')::int)) as "Европа: WS %",
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (props->>'msk_http_ms')::int) as "Москва, мс", percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by (props->>'eu_http_ms')::int) as "Европа, мс"
 from p group by 1 order by 2 desc
